title: AARP
description:
aarp.org Revenue $10 Billion AARP Founded in 1958 by a retired teacher who found a former colleague living in a chicken coop, AARP now serves 38 million Americans over 50 from Washington, built on the idea of serving rather than being served.It is also the country's largest publisher, with a 22-million-copy magazine, a news bulletin, podcasts, film awards, games and about 25 million people a month on its site and app.Its charity arm gives free tax help to 1.7 million people, plus fraud hotlines, legal aid, driver safety courses, tech classes through Senior Planet and wishes for isolated seniors.A volunteer board and its own research institute drive a 21-million-dollar lobbying operation on Social Security, Medicare, drug prices and caregiving, with no candidate endorsements or party ties.
Most income is not the 15-to-20-dollar dues but fees for lending the name to UnitedHealthcare, The Hartford, New York Life, Delta Dental, Expedia and Avis, about 1.2 billion dollars in 2024.
